title: 第13章 氪金改命第14章 薪火相传
content_zh:
青云道院的藏经阁，并非想象中那般金碧辉煌、高耸入云，而是一座半嵌入山腹的石殿，透着股古拙与肃穆。
殿门处，两尊足有三人高的石狮子并非死物，而是时刻吞吐着元气，双目微闭，似在假寐，却有一股无形的威压笼罩着四周，让人不敢造次。
苏秦跨过那道被岁月磨得锃亮的门槛，迎面而来的便是一股混合着墨香、陈旧纸张与灵材特有的奇异香气。
殿内光线略显昏暗，唯有那一排排高耸直至穹顶的巨大书架间，偶尔闪烁着微弱的灵光，那是书籍上自带的禁制光华。
“内舍新晋弟子苏秦，前来选法。”
苏秦走到那张不知用了多少年的紫檀木柜台前，将腰牌递了过去。
柜台后坐着一位发须皆白的陈姓老者，正眯着眼，手里把玩着一对包浆厚重的核桃。
听到声音，慢吞吞地睁开眼，那双有些浑浊的眸子扫了一眼腰牌，并未起身，只是用那略带沙哑的声音说道
“规矩都懂吧？”
“略知一二。”
苏秦拱手道，神态恭谨
“请陈老指教。”
陈老抬起眼皮，深深看了苏秦一眼，手指在桌面上轻轻敲击，发出有节奏的“笃笃”声
“咱们大周藏经阁，不同于宗门秘传，讲究个‘缘’字。”
“这阁里的书，只要你进了藏经阁，尽可随意翻阅，分文不取。”
“若是你天赋异禀，能从那些枯燥的字里行间悟出法术真意，那便是你的机缘。
悟出的法术，归你自己。
哪怕你从一本游记里悟出了管制的‘赤谱’杀伐术，只要去庶务处补个证，朝廷也认，这就是大周对人才的宽容。”
说到这，陈老顿了顿，嘴角勾起一抹似笑非笑的弧度，眼神中带着几分看透世情的戏谑
“当然，若是悟不出来，也不必强求。”

“咱们这也卖现成的‘法种’。
所谓法种，便是朝廷大能将法术精义凝练而成的一道敕令。
买了它，这法术便直接种入你的识海，瞬间入门一级，省去了数月乃至数年的参悟之苦。
这，便是‘以财通神’。”
苏秦点了点头，心中了然。
这简直就是前世游戏里的设定要么肝，要么氪。
大周仙朝，果然把这套修仙逻辑玩得明明白白，给了天才一条路，也给了有钱人一条路。
“多谢陈老。”
苏秦转身走向书架区域，脚步沉稳。
他拿出徐子训给的那枚玉简，神念探入。
玉简中详细列出了四门基础建筑法术
《凝土成石》（造墙）、《化木为梁》（起架）、《琉璃金瓦》（盖顶）、《引灵阵纹》（聚气）。
而在这些法术后面，徐子训还特意用红字备注了一行看似轻描淡写的小字
【此四术皆为基础中的基础，书中道理浅显易懂，乃是稚童启蒙之学。以内舍弟子的资质，定能一看即会，自悟入门，无需破费。】
“一看即会么……”
苏秦走到标注着“土木部”的书架前，抽出那本记载《凝土成石》原理的《地气凝结论》。
书页泛黄，触手粗糙，显然已经被无数人翻阅过。
翻开第一页。
密密麻麻的古篆字映入眼帘，每一个字都仿佛带着某种律动。
“夫土者，地之肉也。欲化土为石，先明其理。土性厚重，石性坚刚。两者之别，在于气之致密度……”

苏秦深吸一口气，耐着性子往下读。
他的神念全开，试图去捕捉字里行间那传说中的“道韵”。
一页，两页，三页……
时间一点点流逝。
一刻钟后。
content_en:
The Sutra Pavilion of Qingyun Taoist Temple is not as magnificent and towering as imagined, but a stone palace half embedded in the mountain, exuding simplicity and solemnity.
At the entrance of the palace, the two stone lions that are three people tall are not dead objects, but are breathing vitality all the time. Their eyes are slightly closed, as if they are sleeping, but there is an invisible coercion surrounding them, making people dare not make mistakes.
Su Qin stepped across the threshold that had been polished by time, and what greeted him was a strange aroma mixed with the fragrance of ink, old paper and spiritual materials.
The light in the hall was slightly dim, and only the rows of huge bookshelves that towered up to the dome occasionally shone with a faint spiritual light, which was the forbidden brilliance of the books.
"Su Qin, the new disciple of Neishe, came to choose the method."
Su Qin walked to the rosewood counter that had been used for unknown years and handed over the badge.
Sitting behind the counter was an old man named Chen with white hair and beard, squinting his eyes and playing with a pair of thickly pulped walnuts in his hand.
Hearing the voice, he slowly opened his eyes. His somewhat cloudy eyes glanced at the waistband. He did not get up, but said in a slightly hoarse voice.
"Do you understand the rules?"
"Know a thing or two."
Su Qin cupped his hands and looked respectful.
"Please give me some advice, Mr. Chen."
Mr. Chen raised his eyelids, took a deep look at Su Qin, and tapped his fingers lightly on the table, making a rhythmic "click" sound.
"Our Da Zhou Sutra Pavilion is different from the sect's secret transmission, which emphasizes the word 'fate'."
"As long as you enter the Sutra Pavilion, you can read the books in this pavilion at will without taking any money."
"If you are gifted and can understand the true meaning of spells from those boring words, that will be your chance.
The magic you realize is your own.
Even if you understand the "chipu" killing technique of control from a travel note, you only need to go to the general affairs office to get a certificate, and the court will recognize it. This is the tolerance of the Great Zhou towards talents. "
Speaking of this, Mr. Chen paused, and the corner of his mouth curved into a smile that was not a smile, and there was a bit of joking in his eyes that could see through the world.
"Of course, if you can't understand it, there's no need to force it."
"We also sell ready-made 'law seeds' here.
The so-called magic type is an edict condensed by the imperial power into the essence of magic.
Once you buy it, this spell will be directly planted into your sea of consciousness, and you will be able to enter the first level in an instant, saving you months or even years of painstaking efforts to comprehend it.
This is ‘using wealth to communicate with gods’. "
Su Qin nodded, understanding in his heart.
This is simply like the setting in the previous game, which is either liver or krypton.
The Immortal Dynasty of the Great Zhou Dynasty really made this logic of cultivating immortals clear and clear, giving both geniuses and wealthy people a path.
"Thank you, Mr. Chen."
Su Qin turned around and walked towards the bookshelf area with steady steps.
He took out the jade slip given by Xu Zixun and penetrated it with his spiritual thoughts.
The jade slip lists four basic building spells in detail.
"Concrete into stone" (building walls), "turning wood into beams" (raising the frame), "glazed gold tiles" (capping), "spiritual formation patterns" (gathering energy).
And behind these spells, Xu Zixun also specially noted a line of small words in red letters that seemed to be an understatement.
[These four techniques are all the foundations of the foundations. The principles in the book are simple and easy to understand. They are enlightenment studies for children. With the qualifications of a disciple of Neishan, he will be able to understand it at a glance and gain self-enlightenment without spending any money. 】
"You will know it at the first glance..."
Su Qin walked to the bookshelf marked "Ministry of Civil Engineering" and pulled out the "Conclusions of Earth's Air Condensation" which recorded the principles of "Condensation into Stone".
The pages are yellowed and the tentacles are rough. It has obviously been read by countless people.
Turn to the first page.
Densely packed ancient seal characters came into view, and each word seemed to carry some kind of rhythm.
"Earth is the flesh of the earth. If you want to turn soil into stone, you must first understand its principles. The nature of soil is thick and heavy, while the nature of stone is hard. The difference between the two lies in the density of Qi..."
Su Qin took a deep breath and read on patiently.
His mind was fully open, trying to capture the legendary "Tao Yun".
One page, two pages, three pages...
Time passes little by little.
A quarter of an hour later.
